description: This file defines the class 'SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator', which helps set up and configure an AdoNet-based stream provider in an Orleans silo. It includes methods to configure options, cache size, and partitioning for the stream provider.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up AdoNet stream provider in an Orleans silo, providing methods to configure options, cache, and partitioning.

methods.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator with name and configuration delegate, setting up logging and validation.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Configures AdoNet options via a provided configuration delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures the cache size for the stream provider, defaulting to a predefined size.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions (queues) for the stream provider.
